summary.text: Eli Sabin is the Democratic candidate for Connecticut House of Representatives District 92 in the November 3, 2026 general election; he won the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary over incumbent Patricia Dillon and Justin Farmer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a New Haven native, a former member of the city's Board of Alders and the legislative coordinator at Connecticut Voices for Children.

paragraphs.text: Eli Sabin's career experience includes working as a public policy advocate.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in New Haven, served on the Board of Alders for six years, and now works as Legislative Coordinator at Connecticut Voices for Children, a nonprofit, where he advocates at the state capitol on housing, child care and health care.
Sabin received 44.3 percent of the vote in the three-way Democratic primary for District 92, ahead of incumbent Patricia Dillon with 35.7 percent and Justin Farmer with 20.0 percent.
In the survey, Sabin listed lowering the cost of living, fully funding public schools and protecting the community from the Trump administration as his key messages.
He named affordable housing, public education, universal health care, and worker and immigrant rights as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
He listed Mayor Justin Elicker and Board of Education member Dr. Edward Joyner among his endorsers.
